rotp_mwp.configuration.title: Stand-Bearing Creatures Configuration
rotp_mwp.configuration.percentageChanceT: Percentage chance for an eligible new mob to receive a Stand.
rotp_mwp.configuration.useEntityWhitelis: False treats entityList as a blacklist; true treats it as a whitelist.
rotp_mwp.configuration.entityList.toolti: Entity type IDs, one per entry. Which mobs can get a Stand depends on Entity List Is a Whitelist: off, the listed entities are excluded; on, only the listed entities qualify.
rotp_mwp.configuration.blockedStandsForM: Stand IDs that mobs are never given, one per entry (for example rotp_zbc:bad_company).
rotp_mwp.configuration.blockedStandActio: Stand ability names that mobs never use, one per entry: the bare name (set_target) or with its namespace (rotp_zbc:set_target).
rotp_mwp.configuration.longRangeStands.t: Stand IDs treated as long-range, one per entry: mobs with them act on targets up to 32 blocks away instead of 12.5.
rotp_mwp.configuration.useAddonStands.to: Off: mobs are only given the core mod's Stands. On: Stands from add-ons can be given too. King Crimson, where installed, is given at a low chance either way; list it under Blocked Stands to keep it out.
rotp_mwp.configuration.smallAnarchyWithS: Allows Stand entities to receive Stand and player-power attachments for Debug Stand nested-power actions. This never adds mob goals or spawn rolls.
rotp_mwp.configuration.dropStandDiscFrom: On: a mob that dies with a Stand drops it as a Stand disc. It does nothing while the core settings Keep Stand on death or Drop Stand Disc are on, which handle drops themselves.
rotp_mwp.configuration.spawnBoy2Man.tool: On: a baby villager that wins the Stand chance roll becomes a kid carrying Boy II Man instead of getting a random Stand.
rotp_mwp.configuration.useWIPComboSystem: On: mobs choose their moves by the Stand's combos (still a work in progress). Off: they pick a random available move each time.
rotp_mwp.configuration.requireStandAdvan: On: mobs only get Stands once some player on the server has earned the advancement "It's Finally Shown Itself!" (Stand fully manifested). Off: they can get them from the start.
